# IOST Terminal

> AI real-time trading platform for crypto + equities. Live market data, AI trade
> scores (0-100 with full subscore breakdown), risk engine, news sentiment,
> IOST on-chain dashboard, paper trading and an autonomous autopilot.
> Paper-first: nothing here moves real money without explicit enablement.

## Key pages

- [Terminal dashboard](/app) — scanner, AI scores, risk, portfolio, on-chain, news, assistant, journal. Deep links: /app#scanner /app#scores /app#risk /app#portfolio /app#onchain /app#news /app#assistant /app#journal
- [Landing](/)
- [3D Automation Hub](/hub) — 8 strategy bots visualized; intel also available as JSON via /api/ui-state

## Machine-readable interfaces

- [Agent discovery manifest](/.well-known/agent.json) — what this service is + where everything lives
- [A2A agent card](/.well-known/agent-card.json) — agent-to-agent capability card
- [Agent API index](/api) — every endpoint, method, body and purpose
- [OpenAPI spec](/openapi.json) — OpenAPI 3.0.3 curated specification
- [Full agent guide](/llms-full.txt) — this index's full-content companion
- [Live platform state](/api/ui-state) — one-call snapshot mirroring the dashboard (scanner, scores, account, autopilot, market, on-chain)
- [Platform meta](/api/meta) — watchlist, account, engine health, data freshness
- [Autopilot proposals](/api/autopilot/proposals) — pending human-in-the-loop entries with full reasoning (symbol, side, size, entry, stop, target, confidence, reason)

## Design docs (repo)

- [Phase 2 wallet design](https://github.com/distrolinux/iost-terminal/blob/main/docs/PHASE2_WALLET.md) — non-custodial Safe 2-of-3 + agent session keys, TEE/MPC custody, funding layer, Coinbase CDP research §9.20–9.26

## Data model

- Watchlist: 16 crypto (IOST, BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, DOT, SUI, ARB, OP, TON, NEAR, LTC) + 9 equities (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, TSLA, AMZN, GOOGL, META, SPY, QQQ)
- AI trade score: 0-100 composite over momentum, technical setup, volume, news sentiment, on-chain activity, risk
- Position Guardian: server-enforced paper bracket/OCO stops and targets, fresh-quote watchdog health, and verified automatic-exit receipts that do not depend on the agent staying online
- Agent Runtime Reliability: owner-bound 30-second heartbeats, readiness leases, mission checkpoints, exact-checkpoint restart recovery, and fail-closed new mission exposure for enrolled agents
- Every page ships a machine layer: server-rendered data table, JSON-LD knowledge graph (Schema.org FinancialProduct/Stock/Offer, ISO 8601 dates, explicit priceCurrency), and a `<script type="application/json" id="agent-state">` state blob

## Important caveats

- Paper execution only. Autopilot trades simulated fills at live prices.
- Stocks data is delayed (Yahoo); crypto is near-real-time (OKX/KuCoin/Gate).
- Autopilot supports requireApproval mode: entries queue as proposals and wait for a human/agent to approve or reject before executing.
- Not financial advice.
